endings.label: FULL TRUTH
endings.title: Tell Mrs Reed the truth
endings.report:
Mrs Reed,

Daniel was staying at Hotel Miramar during the New Horizons conference. The green checked jacket belongs to Claire Sutton. It appeared on Nora Bell in the conference photograph because Nora had borrowed it; she returned it to Claire immediately afterwards.

Claire confirmed that she was at the Miramar with Daniel as his partner. She also said Daniel told her that his wife had died two years ago. I informed her that my client is alive.

This is Claire’s account, supported by the photographs and the events coordinator’s statement.

Detective
endings.reply:
Detective,

So I am dead and he is on holiday. At least one of us is getting some rest.

Thank you for checking instead of simply telling me I was imagining things. Your agreed fee has been paid. What happens between Daniel and me is now my decision.

Mrs Reed
endings.summary: The detective disclosed the confirmed trip, Claire’s account and Daniel’s claim that his wife had died.

endings.label: WITHHOLD
endings.title: Withhold the decisive findings
endings.report:
Mrs Reed,

Your photograph was taken at Hotel Miramar, which hosted the New Horizons conference. I can confirm that the hotel was used for a professional event.

I am closing my inquiry without providing a complete account of Daniel’s private activities.

Detective
endings.replySubject: Re: An expensive lack of answers
endings.reply:
Detective,

I asked you to check his story, not the hotel’s conference facilities.

I have paid the agreed fee, but I do not consider this a satisfactory answer. You have managed to leave me exactly as suspicious as before, only poorer.

Mrs Reed
endings.summary: The detective knowingly withheld Claire’s statement and Daniel’s false claim about his wife’s death.
